title: Phase 1 — cut the Go dependency: ticfac talks to ticks through tk
description: Everything the factory imports from ticks is internal/, which an external Go module physically cannot reach: ticksrc x11, tick x9, operator x9, herd/config x7, operator/telegram/fakebot x4, herd/collect x2, cloud/state x2, plus styles, herd/gitcmd, herd/dashboard, github, gatewaytrace. Promote what the factory needs out of internal/ (recommend pkg/tick, pkg/runners, pkg/questions, pkg/collect, pkg/gitcmd), leaving shims. Also move dashboard.DefaultHarnessBytes so cmd/tk/cmd/root.go:13 stops importing internal/factory/dashboard. Factory code does not move in this phase — it stays where it is and starts importing only pkg/. Semver from day one. LARGEST piece of work in the project, and valuable on its own: a public API is what lets anything build on ticks.
acceptance_criteria: Nothing under cloud/factory or internal/factory imports a ticks internal/ package. cmd/tk/cmd/root.go does not import internal/factory/dashboard. go test ./... green. The public packages carry doc comments stating their compatibility promise.
